sentences.english: I need to take a shower.
I'll be there in ten minutes.
What do you do for fun?
What do you want to eat?
Keep your eye on the ball.
I go to the gym three times a week.
Text me when you get home.
Do you have a bigger size?
How do I get to the station?
I take the bus to school.

grammar.tip: I'm 後面不能直接接動詞原形。要做的事用 I need to ＋動詞。
I 永遠配 am，縮寫就是 I'm。後面接形容詞（tired、hungry）沒問題。
I'm ＋動詞-ing ＝正在做／馬上要做。going 是 -ing，所以前面用 am。
take a shower 是一整組，a 不能掉。
take a break ＝休息一下。take a nap 是小睡、take a picture 是拍照。
搭交通工具：take the bus、take the train，用 the。
just ＝剛剛，事情已經發生了，動詞用過去式。get 的過去式是 got。
做完了要用過去式。take 的過去式是 took，沒有 taked 這個字。

grammar.id: g:I ___ a rice ball for breakfast.
grammar.sentence: I ___ a rice ball for breakfast.
grammar.tip: eat 的過去式是 ate，不規則，要背。
看到 yesterday 就要用過去式。go 的過去式是 went。
leave 的過去式是 left。
Did 已經表示過去了，後面的動詞回到原形。
he、she、it 和一個人、一個東西，都配 is。
we、you、they 和很多人，都配 are。
問「你…嗎？」把 are 放到最前面：Are you …?
主角是 he、she 或一個人，平常會做的事，動詞後面加 s。
my coach ＝一個人＝she 或 he，所以 like 要加 s。
he、she 的「不」用 doesn't，後面的動詞不用再加 s。
I、you、we、they 的「不」用 don't。

grammar.id: g:___ I have a rice ball?
grammar.tip: Can I have …? 點餐萬用句，比 I want 有禮貌。
外帶是 to go，內用是 for here。
Can 後面的動詞一律用原形。
a、e、i、o、u 的音開頭，用 an。
banana 是 b 開頭，用 a。
hour 的 h 不發音，念起來是母音開頭，所以用 an。
星期幾、哪一天用 on。
幾點幾分用 at。
月份、年份用 in。
在家固定講 at home。
are you ＋ -ing ＝現在正在做什麼。
I'm ＋動詞-ing ＝正在做。
現在正在下雨：It's raining。
want 後面接動作，中間要有 to：want to sleep。
have to、need to、want to 後面都接動詞原形。
where ＝哪裡，what ＝什麼，who ＝誰。
What time ＝幾點。
How are you? ＝你好嗎。
How much ＝多少錢。
兩個以上要加 s。
錢不能一個一個數，用 a little。能數的東西（學生、蘋果）才用 a few。

lines.en: I have a cat.
My cat is white.
She is small and cute.
She likes milk.
I love my cat.
The sun is yellow.
The sky is blue.
The tree is green.
My apple is red.
What color do you like?
This is my mom.
This is my dad.
I have a big brother.
We eat cake together.
I am happy.
I get up at seven every day.
I wash my face and brush my teeth.
I eat bread and drink milk for breakfast.
Then I take the bus to school.
My first class is English.
I like my English teacher. She is so nice.
lines.zh: 我喜歡我的英文老師，她人超好。

lines.en: It's Saturday today!
My friends and I go to the park.
We play basketball and fly a kite.
After that, we eat ice cream.
My favorite is chocolate.
I'm tired, but I'm very happy.
It's rainy and cold today.
I can't go outside.
So I stay home and read a book.
My mom makes hot soup for me.
I watch TV with my little sister.
Rainy days are not bad.
There's a convenience store right next to my school.
lines.zh: 我學校旁邊就有一間便利商店。

lines.en: I go there almost every day after class.
lines.zh: 我幾乎每天下課都會去。

lines.en: Sometimes I buy a rice ball, and sometimes I just get a drink.
lines.zh: 有時候買飯糰，有時候只買個飲料。

lines.en: The clerk already knows what I usually order.
lines.zh: 店員已經知道我平常點什麼了。

lines.en: You can pay your bills and pick up packages there, too.
lines.zh: 在那裡還可以繳費、領包裹。

lines.en: Honestly, I don't know what I'd do without it.
lines.zh: 說真的，沒有它我不知道該怎麼辦。

lines.en: I check my phone as soon as I wake up.
I scroll through videos for way too long.
Last week, I spent five hours a day on my phone.
lines.zh: 上週我一天花五個小時在手機上。

lines.en: That's kind of scary, right?
Now I put my phone in another room before bed.
lines.zh: 現在我睡前會把手機放在別的房間。

lines.en: I sleep better, and I feel less stressed.
lines.zh: 我睡得比較好，壓力也變小了。

lines.en: Our volleyball team had a big game last Friday.
lines.zh: 我們排球隊上週五有一場大比賽。

lines.en: We were really nervous before it started.
We lost the first set, and everyone looked down.
lines.zh: 我們輸了第一局，大家看起來都很沮喪。

lines.en: Then our coach said, "Just have fun and trust each other."
lines.zh: 然後教練說：「好好享受，相信彼此。」

lines.en: We came back and won the next two sets.
lines.zh: 我們追回來，贏了接下來兩局。

lines.en: It was the best day of the whole semester.
lines.zh: 那是這學期最棒的一天。

lines.en: Lately, I've been feeling completely drained.
lines.zh: 最近我覺得整個人被掏空。

lines.en: Even small tasks seem overwhelming, and I keep putting things off.
lines.zh: 連小事都讓我覺得喘不過氣，一直拖延。

lines.en: At first, I thought I was just being lazy.
lines.zh: 一開始我以為只是自己太懶。

lines.en: But it turns out burnout is pretty common among students.
lines.zh: 結果發現倦怠在學生之間其實很常見。

lines.en: Now I try to set realistic goals and take short breaks.
lines.zh: 現在我試著訂實際一點的目標，也會短暫休息。

lines.en: It's okay to slow down. Rest is part of the process.
lines.zh: 放慢腳步沒關係，休息也是過程的一部分。

lines.en: These days, a lot of students use AI tools to study.
lines.zh: 現在很多學生用 AI 工具讀書。

lines.en: It can explain difficult concepts in a simple way.
lines.zh: 它能用簡單的方式解釋困難的概念。

lines.en: However, relying on it too much can be a problem.
lines.zh: 不過，太依賴它可能會有問題。

lines.en: If you just copy the answers, you won't actually learn anything.
lines.zh: 如果只是抄答案，你其實什麼都學不到。

lines.en: I use it to check my understanding, not to replace my thinking.
lines.zh: 我用它來確認自己懂不懂，不是用來取代思考。

lines.en: Used wisely, it's like having a tutor in your pocket.
lines.zh: 用得好的話，就像口袋裡有個家教。

lines.en: Last summer, I finally took my first solo trip to Japan.
lines.zh: 去年夏天，我終於一個人去日本旅行。

lines.en: I was anxious about getting lost, since I don't speak Japanese.
lines.zh: 我很擔心迷路，因為我不會講日文。

lines.en: Surprisingly, most people were incredibly patient and helpful.
lines.zh: 出乎意料，大部分的人都超有耐心、很樂意幫忙。

lines.en: I wandered around small streets and tried food I'd never heard of.
lines.zh: 我在小巷子裡亂逛，吃了好多沒聽過的東西。

lines.en: Traveling alone forced me to make decisions on my own.
lines.zh: 一個人旅行逼我自己做決定。

lines.en: I came back more confident than ever.
lines.zh: 回來之後，我比以前都更有自信。

options.en: Just leave it at the front desk.

question.en: Do you know where I can park?
question.zh: 你知道我可以停哪裡嗎？

options.en: The park is beautiful in spring.
There's a garage behind the building.

question.en: Are you going to the conference next week?
What time does the store close tonight?
Should we take a taxi or the MRT?
question.zh: 我們要搭計程車還是捷運？

options.en: The MRT is faster at this hour.

question.en: I can't find my ID badge.
How did the presentation go?
Why don't we postpone the meeting?
Whose umbrella is this?
Would you prefer a window or an aisle seat?
question.zh: 你要靠窗還是靠走道的位子？

question.en: Has the shipment arrived yet?
How often do you work from home?
Didn't you order the supplies already?
question.zh: 你不是已經訂好用品了嗎？

text.en: Hi, I'd like to return this jacket. It's too small.
text.zh: 你好，我想退這件外套，太小了。

text.en: Sure. Do you have the receipt?
text.zh: 好的，你有收據嗎？

text.en: Yes, here it is. Could I exchange it for a larger size instead?
text.zh: 有，在這裡。可以改換大一號的嗎？

text.en: Of course. Let me check if we have a medium in the back.
text.zh: 當然，我去後面看看有沒有 M 號。

text.en: What is the woman's problem?
text.zh: 女子遇到什麼問題？

text.en: What will the man probably do next?
text.zh: 男子接下來可能會做什麼？

text.en: Jenny, are you coming to the team lunch on Friday?
text.zh: Jenny，你星期五會來團隊午餐嗎？

text.en: I want to, but I have a client meeting at noon.
text.zh: 我很想去，但我中午要跟客戶開會。

text.en: That's too bad. Maybe you can join us for dessert after?
text.zh: 好可惜，那之後來一起吃甜點？

text.en: Good idea. I should be done by one thirty.
text.zh: 好主意，我一點半應該就結束了。

text.en: Why can't the woman attend the lunch?
text.zh: 女子為什麼不能參加午餐？

text.en: When will the woman probably be free?
text.zh: 女子大概什麼時候有空？

text.en: The printer on our floor isn't working again.
text.zh: 我們這層的印表機又壞了。

text.en: I know. I called the repair company this morning.
text.zh: 我知道，我早上打給維修公司了。

text.en: When are they coming?
text.zh: 他們什麼時候來？

text.en: Not until tomorrow. You can use the one on the fifth floor for now.
text.zh: 明天才會來。你先用五樓那台吧。

text.en: What are the speakers talking about?
text.zh: 他們在談什麼？

text.en: What does the man suggest?
text.zh: 男子建議什麼？

text.en: Good morning, Sunrise Hotel. How can I help you?
text.zh: 早安，日出飯店，有什麼能為您服務的嗎？

text.en: Hi, I'd like to book a room for two nights, from October 20th.
text.zh: 你好，我想訂房，十月二十號起兩晚。

text.en: Let me check. We have a double room with a city view for 3,200 dollars a night.
text.zh: 我查一下。我們有市景雙人房，一晚三千二。

text.en: That sounds good. Does that include breakfast?
text.zh: 聽起來不錯，有含早餐嗎？

text.en: How many nights does the woman want to stay?
text.zh: 女子想住幾晚？

text.en: What does the woman ask about?
text.zh: 女子問了什麼？

text.en: Mark, did you finish the sales report?
text.zh: Mark，你銷售報告做完了嗎？

text.en: Almost. I'm still waiting for the numbers from the Taichung branch.
text.zh: 快了，我還在等台中分店的數字。

text.en: The manager wants it by three o'clock.
text.zh: 經理三點前要。

text.en: Okay, I'll call them right now and ask them to hurry.
text.zh: 好，我現在就打給他們請他們快一點。

text.en: Why hasn't the man finished the report?
text.zh: 男子為什麼還沒做完報告？

text.en: What will the man do next?
text.zh: 男子接下來會做什麼？

text.en: Excuse me, is this the bus to the airport?
text.zh: 不好意思，這是去機場的公車嗎？

text.en: No, this one goes to the train station. You need the number 9.
text.zh: 不是，這班去火車站。你要搭 9 號。

text.en: Oh, thanks. How often does it come?
text.zh: 喔，謝謝。多久一班？

text.en: Every twenty minutes. The next one should be here soon.
text.zh: 每二十分鐘一班，下一班應該快到了。

text.en: Where does the man want to go?
text.zh: 男子想去哪裡？

text.en: How often does the number 9 bus come?
text.zh: 9 號公車多久一班？

text.en: I heard you're moving to the Singapore office.
text.zh: 聽說你要調去新加坡辦公室。

text.en: That's right. I start there next month.
text.zh: 對，我下個月開始。

text.en: Congratulations! Are you nervous?
text.zh: 恭喜！會緊張嗎？

text.en: A little. I've never lived abroad before, but I'm excited.
text.zh: 有一點，我從來沒住過國外，但我很期待。

text.en: What is the man going to do?
text.zh: 男子要做什麼？

text.en: How does the man feel?
text.zh: 男子感覺如何？

text.en: Hi, I ordered a laptop online, but it hasn't arrived yet.
text.zh: 你好，我在網路上訂了筆電，但還沒送到。

text.en: I'm sorry about that. Can I have your order number?
text.zh: 很抱歉。可以給我您的訂單編號嗎？

text.en: Thank you. It looks like it was delayed because of the typhoon. It should arrive on Thursday.
text.zh: 謝謝。看起來是因為颱風延誤了，星期四應該會到。

text.en: Why is the man calling?
text.zh: 男子為什麼打電話？

options: To ask about a late delivery

text.en: Why was the order delayed?
text.zh: 訂單為什麼延誤？

completions.sentence: All employees must ___ their ID badges at all times.
completions.zh: 所有員工隨時都必須配戴識別證。
completions.tip: must 後面接原形動詞。

completions.sentence: The meeting has been postponed ___ next Tuesday.
completions.zh: 會議延到下週二。
completions.tip: 延到某個時間點用 until（或 to）。

completions.sentence: Ms. Chen is ___ for organizing the annual party.
completions.zh: 陳小姐負責籌辦年度派對。
completions.tip: be responsible for＝負責…，be 後面要形容詞。

completions.sentence: Please submit your report ___ Friday afternoon.
completions.zh: 請在星期五下午前交報告。
completions.tip: by＋時間＝在…之前（期限）。

completions.sentence: The new software is much ___ than the old version.
completions.zh: 新軟體比舊版好用很多。
completions.tip: 有 than 用比較級，easy 的比較級是 easier。

completions.sentence: If you have any questions, please ___ hesitate to contact us.
completions.zh: 如果有任何問題，請不要猶豫跟我們聯絡。
completions.tip: 祈使句的否定是 don't＋原形。

completions.sentence: Our sales ___ by 15 percent last quarter.
completions.zh: 我們上一季業績成長了 15%。
completions.tip: last quarter 是過去時間，用過去式。

completions.sentence: The hotel offers free shuttle service ___ the airport.
completions.zh: 飯店提供往返機場的免費接駁。
completions.tip: 前往某地用 to。

completions.sentence: Mr. Wang has worked here ___ ten years.
completions.zh: 王先生在這裡工作十年了。
completions.tip: for＋一段時間；since＋時間點。

completions.sentence: The package was ___ to the wrong address.
completions.zh: 包裹被送到錯的地址。
completions.tip: was＋過去分詞＝被動語態。

completions.sentence: We need to hire someone ___ can speak Japanese.
completions.zh: 我們需要請一位會講日文的人。
completions.tip: 先行詞是人、在子句當主詞，用 who。

completions.sentence: The conference room is ___ for the whole afternoon.
completions.zh: 會議室整個下午都被訂走了。
completions.tip: be booked＝已被預訂。

completions.sentence: Customers can return items ___ 30 days of purchase.
completions.zh: 顧客可以在購買後 30 天內退貨。
completions.tip: within＋期間＝在…之內。

completions.sentence: The manager asked us to work ___ on the project.
completions.zh: 經理要我們一起合作這個專案。
completions.tip: work together＝一起工作。

completions.sentence: Neither the manager ___ the assistant was at the meeting.
completions.zh: 經理和助理都沒來開會。
completions.tip: neither A nor B＝A 和 B 都不。

completions.sentence: Please make sure the lights are turned off ___ you leave.
completions.zh: 離開前請確認燈都關了。
completions.tip: before＝在…之前。

completions.sentence: The training session will ___ about two hours.
completions.zh: 訓練課程大約兩小時。
completions.tip: last 當動詞＝持續（一段時間）。

completions.sentence: She is one of the most ___ designers in the company.
completions.zh: 她是公司裡最有才華的設計師之一。
completions.tip: 名詞前面要形容詞，talented＝有才華的。

completions.sentence: The price ___ tax and delivery.
completions.zh: 價格包含稅和運費。
completions.tip: 主詞 The price 是單數，現在式動詞加 s。

completions.sentence: We look forward to ___ from you soon.
completions.zh: 期待很快收到您的回覆。
completions.tip: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。

completions.sentence: The store will be closed ___ the national holiday.
completions.zh: 國定假日期間店會休息。
completions.tip: during＋名詞；while＋子句。

completions.sentence: Applicants should send their résumés ___ email.
completions.zh: 應徵者請用電子郵件寄履歷。
completions.tip: by email＝用電子郵件。

completions.sentence: The flight was delayed ___ heavy rain.
completions.zh: 班機因為大雨延誤。
completions.tip: due to＋名詞；because＋子句。

completions.sentence: It is important ___ all staff attend the safety training.
completions.zh: 所有員工都參加安全訓練是很重要的。
completions.tip: It is important that＋子句。

completions.sentence: The new branch is ___ located near the train station.
completions.zh: 新分店位在火車站附近，很方便。
completions.tip: 修飾形容詞 located 要用副詞。

completions.sentence: I have ___ finished reading the contract.
completions.zh: 我剛看完合約。
completions.tip: 現在完成式的肯定句用 just＝剛剛。

completions.sentence: Mr. Lee will call you back as soon as he ___ the meeting.
completions.zh: 李先生一開完會就會回你電話。
completions.tip: 時間副詞子句用現在式代替未來式。

completions.sentence: There are ___ seats left for the concert.
completions.zh: 演唱會的位子只剩幾個。
completions.tip: seats 可數；a few＝還有幾個（肯定語氣）。

completions.sentence: The company is looking for ways to reduce ___.
completions.zh: 公司在找減少成本的方法。
completions.tip: reduce 後面接名詞當受詞。

completions.sentence: Please read the instructions ___ before using the machine.
completions.zh: 使用機器前請仔細閱讀說明。
completions.tip: 修飾動詞 read 用副詞。

completions.sentence: The report was written ___ the marketing team.
completions.zh: 這份報告是行銷團隊寫的。
completions.tip: 被動語態的動作者用 by。

completions.sentence: Each department ___ its own budget.
completions.zh: 每個部門有自己的預算。
completions.tip: Each＋單數名詞，動詞用單數。

essayTopics: A Place I Want to Go
